card.name: Inside micafungin and mycotic words
card.fires_on: The partial piece "mic" inside micafungin, and the "c" or "yc" piece inside mycotic or mycobacterial words, in drug-label text. It fires before the word is finished.

modes.label: Micafungin start
modes.description: The "mic" piece that begins the antifungal drug name micafungin.
modes.example: Do not mix or co-infuse<< mic>>afungin for injection with other medications

modes.label: Mycotic words
modes.description: The "c" or "yc" piece partway through mycotic or antimycobacterial terms.
modes.example: genital my<<c>>otic infections in both male and female patients

card.writes: It pushes toward finishing odd word pieces and away from mushroom and fungus words, so it adds no clear fungal vocabulary.
card.plain: It lights up partway through fungus-related words like micafungin and mycotic, before the word is complete.
